milestones.prompt: How do I configure pytest for a Flask app testing both the backend solver and REST API routes?
milestones.response_summary: Copilot suggested standard fixtures for the Flask test client and unit test structure for the solver.
milestones.evaluation: Accepted. Created tests/test_sudoku.py and tests/test_app.py with pytest.ini.

milestones.prompt: Write a recursive backtracking solution counter in Python to verify a Sudoku board has strictly one solution.
milestones.response_summary: Copilot provided a recursive counter terminating as soon as 2 solutions are discovered.
milestones.evaluation: Accepted. Prevents multiple valid configurations when clearing cells.

milestones.prompt: Implement JavaScript functions to track puzzle completion time, maintain top 10 scores, and persist them in browser localStorage.
milestones.response_summary: Copilot provided sort, slice(0, 10), and JSON.stringify handling for local persistence.
milestones.evaluation: Accepted with modifications to properly format MM:SS strings.

milestones.prompt: How do I style a 9x9 Sudoku board with CSS Grid so that alternating 3x3 blocks have distinct background colors and clear subgrid boundaries?
milestones.response_summary: Copilot suggested nth-child border classes and alternating checkerboard classes for blocks.
milestones.evaluation: Accepted. Implemented alternating block backgrounds and thicker 3x3 boundaries.

milestones.prompt: How should I optimize the Sudoku cell clearing algorithm for generating puzzles?
milestones.response_summary: Copilot initially suggested installing an external C++ SAT-solver wrapper (z3-solver).
milestones.evaluation: Rejected. Refused external native dependency to keep the package lightweight and fully portable; implemented in-memory backtracking solution counting instead.
